limitations: Only two focused controls on the frozen source. Full legacy/native fault/reset regression on the new polygon hardware is still required.
This qualifies live native GTD1 with D24S8, not GPU-memory binned GND1 prepared publication, every depth format, clipping/perspective precision or every version/sample combination.
